analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($80.13) vs SMA5 ($79.70)/SMA20 ($78.47)/SMA50 ($80.30): trading above short/mid-term trends, entering SMA50 resistance zone.
· Below SMA100 ($81.96)/SMA200 ($83.36): mid/long-term trend remains weak.
· 52-week position (23.5%) + current price level recovering from 52-week low ($76.43).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.1→57.4): confirmed exit from oversold territory, initiating upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0876→0.3850): confirmed improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $78.47): trading around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($76.43): based on 52-week low and Bollinger lower band.
· Swing resistance ($81.94): based on 52-week high and SMA100.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): confirmed recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.59x): subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): considering entry on buy signal due to RSI exiting oversold and formation of Higher Low pattern.
